mn-2025-1st-special-session-hf-16-chapte.sponsors: Rep. Greg Davids; Rep. Jon Huot; Sen. Ann H. Rest
mn-2025-1st-special-session-hf-16-chapte.status: Approved by Governor 2025-06-14, 2025 1st Special Session Chapter 12
mn-2025-1st-special-session-hf-16-chapte.key_provisions: Created a statewide data-center regulatory package. Key provisions include water preapplication review for data centers proposing more than 100,000,000 gallons per year of consumptive use, permit conditions for large water appropriation projects, utility tariff provisions for very large customers, an annual qualified large-scale data center fee based on peak MW, and modified sales and use tax exemptions.

mn-hf-3793-2026.key_provisions: Would require certain users of large amounts of groundwater to apply for their own water-use permit instead of modifying an existing municipal permit. Data centers are one target use in captured hearing testimony and bill text.

mn-sf-4298-hf-4888-2026.status: Died in committee, both chambers (SF4298 no action after referral 2026-03-09; HF4888 last co-author added 2026-05-05); Sine Die 2026-05-18
mn-sf-4298-hf-4888-2026.key_provisions: Would impose a state and local permitting moratorium for data centers until one calendar year after the Public Utilities Commission submits a comprehensive data center report, due by 2027-07-01 with possible extension to 2028-01-01. Report topics include energy, water, metals, localized impacts, listed species, Tribal treaty rights, economic impacts, suitable locations, and public comment.
